title: paraview-time-annotation.json
body:
{
  "version": "schemaxis/1",
  "nodes": [
    {"id": "clock", "filter": "pvTimeSource"},
    {"id": "ball", "filter": "sphere"},
    {"id": "label", "filter": "pvAnnotateTimeFilter", "inputs": {"Input": "clock"},
     "options": {"Format": "t = {time:.3f}"}}
  ],
  "times": {"source": "clock", "select": {"values": [0, 1], "tolerance": 1e-9}},
  "scenes": [
    {"id": "labelled",
     "visible": {"ball": {"colour": "steelblue"},
                 "label": {"fontSize": 28, "colour": [0.8, 0.1, 0.1], "position": "Upper Center",
                           "justification": "Center", "bold": true}},
     "appearances": [{}, {"label": {"fontSize": 16, "position": "Lower Right Corner",
                                    "justification": "Right", "bold": false, "italic": true}}],
     "images": [{"id": "view", "size": [320, 240], "cameras": [{"direction": [1, -1, 1]}]}]},
    {"id": "plain",
     "visible": {"ball": {"colour": "steelblue"}},
     "images": [{"id": "view", "size": [320, 240], "cameras": [{"direction": [1, -1, 1]}]}]}
  ]
}
